# COz Cos

> COz Cos is a cosplay service brand in Taiwan. Services include makeup, costumes and photography experiences, costume rentals and sales, in-person makeup lessons, makeup services in northern and central Taiwan, and Xianyu/Taobao purchasing assistance.

## Locations
新北・鶯歌車站附近 ／ 台中・南屯捷運附近。Near Yingge Train Station, New Taipei and Nantun MRT Station, Taichung. Exact locations, availability and pricing must be confirmed through official Instagram. Package and individual service prices are published on the price list; no full street address is published here.
